message.text: Decision: adopt PostgreSQL outbox consumers for v1, retain Go, EU-only storage, and EUR 900/month ceiling. Do not claim a measured cost. Use six consumers for the initial peak target, subject to load validation. Given only 100 GiB free, identify the retention risk and propose a bounded backpressure and recovery plan.
